sloka: कामं खलु न मे शक्ता निबद्धस्यापि राक्षसाः ।छित्त्वा पाशान् समुत्पत्य हन्यामहमिमान् पुनः ।। 5.53.11।।।।
transliteration: kāmaṁ khalu na me śaktā nibaddhasyāpi rākṣasāḥ ।chittvā pāśān samutpatya hanyāmahamimān punaḥ ।। 5.53.11।।।।

translations.english: 'Even though these ogres are not capable, they have bound me. Indeed I will leap (into the air) once again and sever my bonds and kill them.
